scope_outcomes.criterion: Explicit or reconstructed valuations preserving their holder, target, attribution, and qualification.
scope_outcomes.basis: The text explicitly identifies capitalism's supreme economic value and rational mastery, affirms autonomy as worthwhile, evaluates solidarity and contestation positively, and values activities solely in monetary terms; the definition of autonomous society is also explicit.
limitations: Some positive values are reconstructed from explicit condemnations rather than formulated as a complete alternative ethic.
scope_outcomes.review_basis: Verified against the source; F1 weakened to remove the monetary claim, V.F1 added for that claim; V.F2 added for the definition of autonomous society.
